name: branding-gradient-logo-grid-white-marks
title: Twelve white logos on a yellow-to-magenta gradient grid
whatItIs: A 3x4 grid of cells whose backgrounds blend from yellow through blue and violet to magenta, each with a white logo and wordmark for a different fictional brand (home, eco, chat, docs, tech).
whatItMeans: Modern, variety-rich and energetic; a shared white treatment and gradient make unrelated logos read as one collection.
techniques: Show logos as white on one continuous gradient split into tiles.
Pair each icon with a wordmark in clean sans, bold and regular weights.
Keep the same size and alignment in each cell.
Use white gutters to make a modular sheet.
bestFor: Comparing marks for tech and startup brands

vocabulary.definition: A grid of logos presented together.
A cell filled with part of a continuing gradient.
A logo in white on colour.
A lockup of symbol and name.
